segments.text: What is the oldest tree in the world?
Many people think of a great oak
But there is an ancient tree far older than any oak
High in the mountains of California
A bristlecone pine has survived for over 4,000 years
It is one of the oldest living trees on earth
Compared with other pines, it may add only a few millimeters each year
But it is far stronger in the high mountains
The air is thin, the wind is cold, and the soil is poor
Yet such a harsh environment is
What has enabled the long life of this tree
Scientists measure the age of these trees
From growth rings within the wood
One has been found to be more than 4,800 years old
We cannot help admiring the tree
That is older than many civilizations
It is among the most remarkable living beings carrying silence and strength together
